storeListingCopy.fullDescription:
SERP Stripchat Downloader makes it easy to record live streams and download videos from Stripchat.com.

How it works: Go to any model's page on Stripchat while the stream is live, then click the download button on the player or the extension icon in your toolbar. The extension detects the live stream, shows available quality options, and starts recording. When you stop the capture or the stream ends, it saves as a standard MP4 file.

It also downloads recorded videos from model profiles. Navigate to any video page and the extension detects the source automatically.

The extension handles Stripchat's LL-HLS streaming, multi-CDN infrastructure, and Mouflon manifest encryption automatically — no external tools, no command line, no technical knowledge required. Videos save directly to your Downloads folder.

Key features:
- Live stream recording with real-time progress and elapsed time tracking
- Recorded video (VOD) downloads from model profiles
- Automatic HLS stream detection across multiple Stripchat CDN domains
- Handles Mouflon-encrypted manifests transparently
- In-page download button right on the video player
- Converts HLS streams to standard MP4 files in your browser
- Quality selection from all available resolutions (1080p, 720p, etc.)
- Real-time download progress with capture duration display
- Right-click context menu for quick recording
- Dark-themed UI with pink-red accents matching Stripchat's style
- 3 free downloads to try before you buy

Getting started:
1. Install the extension
2. Go to Stripchat.com and open a model's live stream
3. Click the download button on the player or the extension icon
4. Select quality and start recording — saves as MP4

Sign in with your email to unlock 3 free trial downloads. Upgrade to a license for unlimited downloads.

Supports Chrome, Edge, Brave, Opera, Firefox, and more.

faq.question: How do I record a live stream?
faq.answer: Go to any model's page on Stripchat.com while they are live. Click the download button on the player or the extension icon. Select your preferred quality and click Download. The extension starts recording and shows elapsed time. Click Stop when you want to end the recording.

faq.question: Can I download recorded videos too?
faq.answer: Yes. Navigate to any video on a model's profile page (the /videos/ section). The extension detects the video source and lets you download it as MP4.

faq.question: What quality options are available?
faq.answer: The extension detects all available qualities from Stripchat's HLS manifest — typically multiple resolutions up to 1080p. Formats include frame rate information when available.

faq.question: What format are downloaded videos?
faq.answer: All videos and recordings are saved as standard MP4 files that play on any device or media player.

faq.question: How many free downloads do I get?
faq.answer: 3 free trial downloads after signing in with your email. Purchase a license for unlimited downloads.

faq.question: Does this work on Firefox?
faq.answer: Yes — supports Chrome, Edge, Brave, Opera, Whale, Yandex, and Firefox.

faq.question: Why does the extension say the model is offline?
faq.answer: The model must be actively streaming for live capture to work. If the model is offline or in a private show, the extension will display a status message. Wait for the public stream to resume.

faq.question: What if the model is in a private show?
faq.answer: Private shows cannot be recorded. The extension will display a message asking you to wait until the public stream resumes.

faq.question: Is my data safe?
faq.answer: Yes. Stream recording and video processing happen entirely in your browser. Authentication uses secure OTP — no passwords stored.
